title: WS-002 - Authenticate to the EUSurvey Web-services API
intent: Explain how authentication works for technical integrations with the EUSurvey Web-services API.
short_answer: The EUSurvey Web-services API uses Basic Authentication. The USERNAME and PASSWORD of a valid system user must be sent in the HTTP header of each request. Existing EU Login users are not supported for API access, whether they are internal or external users.
procedure: Obtain a valid EUSurvey system user for the integration.
Encode the username and password according to Basic Authentication rules in the HTTP Authorization header.
Send the Authorization header with every API request.
Do not rely on an interactive EU Login session or EU Login account credentials for Web-services API calls.
important_conditions: Wrong username or password normally results in HTTP 403.
Credential handling should follow the security rules of the integrating system.
Contact EUSurvey support if a system user is needed or if authentication fails unexpectedly.
